$comment: The text-to-speech round trip: each sentence is spoken by nuclis speak (speaker, language, and seed as given) and recognized by nuclis transcribe; scripts/wer.py --speak scores the words against the text. Written for nuclis (no third-party text); numbers are spelled as they are said, so the recognizer's words can match them. docs/models/qwen3-tts.md § The round trip.
speaker: ryan
